name: Maverick Analyzer - Pallette
desc: (Quick Effect): You can discard this card and 1 other card; Special Summon 1 "Maverick Hunter" monster from your GY, and if it is an "Axl" monster, you can add from your Deck 1 "Maverick Boost" Equip Spell Card. If this card is in the GY: You can target 1 of your banished "Maverick Hunter" or "Maverick Boost" cards; shuffle both this card and the targeted card into the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Maverick Analyzer - Pallette" once per turn.
strings: Shuffle banished card and this card into Deck
